notes: A school edition of Euripides' Hecuba: verse text plus a two-column commentary, correctly read with full polytonic marks (3-9, 11-14, 23, 31, 35). The final-sigma flag is wrong: 28-31 and 36-38 are elided forms ('λιποῦσ᾽', 'ἀλλάξασ᾽', 'ζῶσ᾽') printed with apostrophe and medial σ, so they are correct. The real weakness is the commentary's '=' gloss sign. It is dropped in 15, 16 and 20, turned into '–' in 21 and 25, read as 'Ξ' in 26 ('Ξὑπερανεστηκυῖα') and as 'τ-' in 27, and no regex can isolate it reliably. This affects a minority of the commentary lines, and 40 is a garbled two-line crop. Not enough to drop the book.
